scope: Draft PR 75; isolated localhost:3351 and PostgreSQL only; no Production changes
outcome: NBA announcement published automatically after model audit; DIMAYOR kept private after final quality rejection

publication.verification: Publisher-advertised RSS headline and body corroboration plus bounded primary-page inspection; no publisher prose retained or supplied to the model
publication.identity: NBA competition link only. Aggregate announcement has no individual team/player claims; no fabricated franchise associations or crests.

dimayor.decision: Eligible facts; generated article requires editorial review and remains private

finalAudit.reason: Repetition in all three body fields after the single bounded correction

dimayor.diagnosis: Initial auditor incorrectly interpreted the body character minimum as a word minimum. Correction added repetition, which the final independent audit rejected. Rubric now explicitly says CHARACTERS, NOT words, no word minimum, no padding. That prompt fix has not received a further real model canary.

sixCandidateDecisions.reason: Product feature/availability claims need a bounded feature contract and region/platform qualifications; marketing language must not become verified sporting fact.

sixCandidateDecisions.item: Trae Young NBA Cares offseason award
sixCandidateDecisions.reason: Primary headline and page identify recipient and award. An award-specific extractor, period/team corroboration and audited publication are not yet operational; do not treat it as a game result.

sixCandidateDecisions.result: Facts accepted; prose rejected for repetition. Private editorial review required, no more calls this batch.

sixCandidateDecisions.reason: Existing local published Llaneros–Cali story research-dimayor-46651e96 already cites this exact source. Preserved; not republished.
Historical retrospective, not a new Primera A result or low-ambiguity event. Requires historical result verification and appropriate women's competition classification.

contracts.common: Mandatory primary identity, clean canonical URL, source publication date, observedAt, sport, competition, source-specific corroboration and facts hash. Current within seven days. Unknown source/type adapters fail closed. No quotes, images, article copying, invented context or statistical database reuse.
contracts.league-announcement: Authority, action and subject; only that confirmed action may be asserted; source adapter still required.
contracts.competition-decision: Authority, decision and effective date; no inferred reasons or effects; source adapter still required.
contracts.fixture-announcement: Two distinct participants, stage, action and named referee for current adapter; no score, date or venue inference.
contracts.draw: Stage and exact confirmed pairings; no invented bracket path or fixtures; source adapter still required.
contracts.schedule-change: Participants, old/new start and timezone; contradictory times block; source adapter still required.
contracts.ranking: Named ranking, effective date and named ranked entries; no proprietary ranking feed permission inferred; source adapter still required.
contracts.roster-announcement: Explicit season, opening-night scope and reconciled aggregate player/country/continent counts; no individual affiliations inferred.
contracts.award: Recipient, award and period; no unsupported achievements, donation amounts or team affiliation; source adapter still required.

safety.execution: One explicitly Owner-authorized local batch, not evidence of unattended daily operation. Daily run/request/cost ceilings retained. Earlier preflight failures made no model calls. One approved NBA draft reused after JSONB hash-order bug fix, without regeneration. Reservations were not refunded or erased.
safety.deduplication: Isolated PostgreSQL repeated observation unchanged, second publication rejected. NBA public record appears once. Existing private metadata placeholders preserved; edited/reviewed/archived Owner drafts still block publication.
safety.corrections: Changed source facts withdraw the public claim and quarantine revision; history retained.

remaining: DIMAYOR has no new AI publication. Its retained private draft and rejection evidence remain inspectable for seven days; a future bounded run must independently validate the clarified rubric.
No demonstrated autonomous publications for MLB, NFL, NHL, UFC, tennis or EuroLeague in this change. Typed contracts do not equal operational source coverage.
No repeated unattended daily publication claim. Existing scheduler integration is tested, but live batch was Owner-directed and local automation is paused.
Broader primary-source adapters and reuse/access reviews remain necessary; restricted sources are not bypassed.
Source verification and model audits reduce risk; they do not guarantee factual perfection, copyright clearance or platform approval.
